<body class="skin-vector-legacy mediawiki ltr sitedir-ltr mw-hide-empty-elt ns-0 ns-subject mw-editable page-后勤技能一览 rootpage-后勤技能一览 skin-vector action-view webfonts-changed"><div id="mw-page-base" class="noprint"></div>

	<div id="siteNotice"><div id="localNotice" data-nosnippet=""><div class="sitenotice" lang="zh-Hans-CN" dir="ltr"><div class="nomobile"><div style="box-sizing:border-box; max-width:800px; min-height:32px; margin:5px auto 10px; padding:3px 1em; background:linear-gradient(to right, rgba(255,255,255,0), var(--yellow, #f9e179) clamp(0px, calc(50% - 220px), 20%), var(--yellow, #f9e179) calc(100% - clamp(0px, calc(50% - 220px), 20%)), rgba(255,255,255,0)); color:#2a2a19; font-size:16px; font-weight:bold; line-height:26px; text-align:center; text-shadow:0px 0px 2px white, 1px 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.6); --ak-link:#005a82; --ak-link-hover:#003d59; --ak-link-visited:#005a82; --color-progressive:#005a82; --color-progressive--hover:#003d59; --color-visited:#005a82;">我们正在测试新版皮肤（ <style>
/* 普通链接外观：颜色 / 悬停 / 访问色都不在这里定，交给皮肤自带的 a 规则，自动跟随主题。
   注意元素不带 href，所以不会进入 :visited，永远是主题的「正常链接色」而不是已访问色。 */
.skin-switch {
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
body.skin-minerva a.skin-switch[role="link"] {
  color: var(--color-progressive, var(--ak-link, #36c));
}
body.skin-minerva a.skin-switch[role="link"]:hover {
  color: var(--color-progressive--hover, var(--ak-link-hover, var(--color-progressive, var(--ak-link, #36c))));
}
.skin-switch[aria-disabled="true"] {
  opacity: 0.6;
  cursor: progress;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.skin-switch:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--ak-focus, currentColor);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
/* 页面的解析缓存各皮肤共用，链接文字不能在服务端定，两种都输出、按 body 上的皮肤类二选一 */
body.skin-arknights .skin-switch__to-new,
body:not(.skin-arknights) .skin-switch__to-old { display: none; }
</style><script>
(window.RLQ = window.RLQ || []).push(function () {
  var NEW_SKIN = 'arknights';
  var YEAR = 365 * 24 * 3600;

  // m.prts.wiki 与 prts.wiki 共用：cookie 写在去掉 m. 的域名上；localhost / IP 不带 Domain
  function cookieDomain() {
    var host = location.hostname.replace(/^m\./, '');
    return /^[\d.]+$/.test(host) || host.indexOf('.') === -1 ? '' : '; domain=.' + host;
  }
  function setCookie(name, value) {
    var domain = cookieDomain();
    // 先清掉当前域名下同名的 host-only cookie（不带 Domain，手动加的或别处写的）：
    // 它只发给这一个域名，留着的话两个域名对皮肤的判断不一致，恢复默认时也清不掉
    if (domain) {
      document.cookie = name + '=; path=/; max-age=0';
    }
    document.cookie = name + '=' + value + '; path=/' + domain +
      (value ? '; max-age=' + YEAR : '; max-age=0') + '; samesite=lax' +
      (location.protocol === 'https:' ? '; secure' : '');
  }
  function hasCookie(name) {
    return ('; ' + document.cookie).indexOf('; ' + name + '=') !== -1;
  }
  function isBusy(el) {
    return el.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true';
  }

  function switchSkin(el) {
    var toNew = mw.config.get('skin') !== NEW_SKIN;
    // 空串 = 站点默认皮肤
    var target = toNew ? NEW_SKIN : (el.getAttribute('data-old') || '');
    var cookie = el.getAttribute('data-cookie') || 'akskin';
    if (!/^[a-z0-9-]*$/.test(target) || !/^[\w-]+$/.test(cookie)) {
      return;
    }
    var fromMobile = cookie + '_m';
    var loggedIn = mw.config.get('wgUserName') !== null;
    var anonCookie = el.getAttribute('data-anon') !== 'useskin';
    var persistent = loggedIn || anonCookie;

    var url = new URL(location.href);
    url.searchParams.delete('useskin');
    url.searchParams.delete('mobileaction');

    if (persistent) {
      // 登录用户也写：Varnish 看到它就不再把手机 UA 引到移动版，换设备 / 退出登录后也还认
      setCookie(cookie, target);
      // 移动版（MobileFrontend）强制 Minerva，新皮肤只在桌面域名上有；借 Varnish 现成的
      // mobileaction 开关过去，并记一笔，切回旧皮肤时再把人送回移动版
      if (toNew && mw.config.get('wgMFMode') && /^m\./.test(location.hostname)) {
        url.hostname = location.hostname.replace(/^m\./, '');
        url.searchParams.set('mobileaction', 'toggle_view_desktop');
        setCookie(fromMobile, '1');
      } else if (!toNew && hasCookie(fromMobile)) {
        setCookie(fromMobile, '');
        url.hostname = 'm.' + location.hostname;
        url.searchParams.set('mobileaction', 'toggle_view_mobile');
      }
    } else if (target) {
      url.searchParams.set('useskin', target);
    }

    function go() {
      if (url.href === location.href) {
        location.reload();
      } else {
        location.assign(url.href);
      }
    }

    el.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
    mw.notify(
      (toNew ? '正在切换到新版皮肤…' : '正在恢复默认皮肤…') +
        (persistent ? '' : '未登录时只对当前页面生效，登录后切换可以保存。'),
      { tag: 'skin-switch' }
    );

    if (!loggedIn) {
      go();
      return;
    }
    mw.loader.using('mediawiki.api').then(function () {
      // 值为 null = 恢复成站点默认值
      return new mw.Api().saveOption('skin', target || null);
    }).then(go, function () {
      el.removeAttribute('aria-disabled');
      mw.notify('皮肤切换失败，请稍后再试，或到「参数设置 → 外观」里手动切换。', { type: 'error', tag: 'skin-switch' });
    });
  }

  function pick(e) {
    var el = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.skin-switch');
    return el && !isBusy(el) ? el : null;
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var el = pick(e);
    if (el) {
      switchSkin(el);
    }
  });

  // role="link" 的元素不会自己响应键盘，Enter / 空格要手动处理
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key !== 'Enter' && e.key !== ' ') {
      return;
    }
    var el = pick(e);
    if (el) {
      e.preventDefault();
      switchSkin(el);
    }
  });
});
</script><a class="skin-switch" role="link" tabindex="0" aria-disabled="false" data-old="" data-anon="cookie" data-cookie="akskin"><span class="skin-switch__to-new">切换至新版</span><span class="skin-switch__to-old">切换至旧版</span></a> | <a href="/w/PRTS:%E6%88%91%E4%BB%AC%E6%AD%A3%E5%9C%A8%E6%B5%8B%E8%AF%95%E6%96%B0%E7%9A%84%E7%BD%91%E7%AB%99%E7%9A%AE%E8%82%A4" title="PRTS:我们正在测试新的网站皮肤">了解详情</a> ）</div></div><div class="mobileonly nodesktop"><div style="box-sizing:border-box; min-height:24px; padding:3px 8px; background-color:var(--yellow, #f9e179); color:#2a2a19; font-size:12px; font-weight:bold; line-height:18px; text-align:center; text-shadow:0px 0px 2px white, 1px 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.6); --ak-link:#005a82; --ak-link-hover:#003d59; --ak-link-visited:#005a82; --color-progressive:#005a82; --color-progressive--hover:#003d59; --color-visited:#005a82;">我们正在测试新版皮肤（ <a class="skin-switch" role="link" tabindex="0" aria-disabled="false" data-old="" data-anon="cookie" data-cookie="akskin"><span class="skin-switch__to-new">切换至新版</span><span class="skin-switch__to-old">切换至旧版</span></a> | <a href="/w/PRTS:%E6%88%91%E4%BB%AC%E6%AD%A3%E5%9C%A8%E6%B5%8B%E8%AF%95%E6%96%B0%E7%9A%84%E7%BD%91%E7%AB%99%E7%9A%AE%E8%82%A4" title="PRTS:我们正在测试新的网站皮肤">了解详情</a> ）</div></div></div></div></div>

</td>

<td>进驻宿舍时，每<span style="color:#0098DC;">1</span>层<span class="mc-tooltips"><span class="term" style="text-decoration:underline ;white-space:nowrap;text-shadow: 0 0 1px;color:inherit;cursor:help;" aria-expanded="false"><span style="color:#F49800;">梦境</span></span><span style="display:none" data-size="350" data-interactive="true" data-append-to="body"><strong>术语: <span style="color:#F49800;">梦境</span></strong><br>可影响<span class="term" style="text-decoration:underline ;white-space:nowrap;text-shadow: 0 0 1px;color:inherit;cursor:help;"><span style="color:#F49800;">感知信息</span></span>相关变量<br>由以下干员的基建技能提供<br>爱丽丝</span></span>转化为<span style="color:#0098DC;">1</span>点<span class="mc-tooltips"><span class="term" style="text-decoration:underline ;white-space:nowrap;text-shadow: 0 0 1px;color:inherit;cursor:help;" aria-expanded="false"><span style="color:#F49800;">感知信息</span></span><span style="display:none" data-size="350" data-interactive="true" data-append-to="body"><strong>术语: <span style="color:#F49800;">感知信息</span></strong><br>可影响<span class="term" style="text-decoration:underline ;white-space:nowrap;text-shadow: 0 0 1px;color:inherit;cursor:help;"><span style="color:#F49800;">思维链环</span></span>、<span class="term" style="text-decoration:underline ;white-space:nowrap;text-shadow: 0 0 1px;color:inherit;cursor:help;"><span style="color:#F49800;">无声共鸣</span></span>相关变量<br>由以下干员的基建技能提供<br>迷迭香、黑键、夕、令、絮雨、爱丽丝、车尔尼</span></span>
